nodes.name: dommatrix.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the DOMMatrix interface for mutable 2D/3D transformation matrices in the Servo DOM, extending DOMMatrixReadOnly with methods that mutate the matrix in place. Provides a full WebIDL binding with constructors from strings, sequences, and typed arrays, as well as mutating transform operations (translate, scale, rotate, skew, invert) and serialization support.
nodes.languageNotes: Rust DOM struct with #[dom_struct] attribute; inherits from DOMMatrixReadOnly via a parent field pattern used in Servo's DOM implementation.

nodes.name: dommatrixreadonly.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the DOMMatrixReadOnly interface for immutable 2D/3D transformation matrices. Stores a Transform3D matrix and an is2D flag, provides all getter properties (m11-m44, a-f), non-mutating transform computations (translate, scale, rotate, skew, inverse, flip), string serialization, and the transform-to-matrix CSS parser used by both matrix types.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Servo's dom_struct and DomRefCell for interior mutability; validates and fixes up matrix initialization dictionaries per the Geometry Interfaces spec.

nodes.name: dompoint.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the DOMPoint interface for mutable 2D/3D points (x, y, z, w coordinates). Extends DOMPointReadOnly and provides setters for all coordinates, constructors from individual values or dictionary, and IPDL serialization.

nodes.name: dompointreadonly.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the DOMPointReadOnly interface for immutable 2D/3D points. Stores x, y, z, w as Cell<f64> values, provides read accessors and a MatrixTransform method that applies a DOMMatrix to transform the point, returning a new DOMPoint. Also defines the DOMPointWriteMethods trait implemented by the mutable variant.

nodes.name: domquad.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the DOMQuad interface representing a quadrilateral defined by four DOMPoint corners (p1, p2, p3, p4). Provides constructors from individual points, from DOMRect, and from dictionary; computes the axis-aligned bounding rectangle via getBounds; supports IPDL serialization.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Dom<T> for DOM references to the four corner points and iterates them with nan_safe_minimum/nan_safe_maximum for bounds computation.
